evidence.quote: We also decided that in October we will begin the balance sheet normalization program that we outlined in June.
additional gradual rate hikes are likely to be appropriate over the next few years to sustain the economic expansion.
in light of the unexpected lower inflation readings this year, the Committee is monitoring inflation developments closely.
The labor market has strengthened substantially.
So there are risks on both sides to our objectives, and most of my colleagues and I have concluded that a gradual path of rate increases
We are working down our balance sheet because we feel that's stimulus that in some sense is no longer needed.

parsed.rationale: The Chair held rates but launched balance sheet runoff and reiterated expectations of gradual further hikes, citing strong labor markets and overheating risk. Concern about persistently low inflation and two-sided risks tempers the hawkish lean.
